## Skitter Rat (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
CN Small magical beast  
**Init** +6; **Senses** aura sight 30 ft., blindsense 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., Perception +5  


**Defense**


**AC** 14, touch 13, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +1 natural, +1 size)  
**hp** 20 (2d10)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +5, **Will** +1  
**Weaknesses** light blindness  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft., climb 40 ft.  
**Melee** bite +3 (1d6 plus bleed)  
**Special Attacks** bleed (1), swarming  


**Statistics**


**Str** 10, **Dex** 15, **Con** 11, **Int** 5, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +1; **CMD** 13 (17 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Improved Initiative  
**Skills** Climb +20, Perception +5, Stealth +14; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception, +4 Stealth  
**Languages** Undercommon (cannot speak), telepathy 100 ft (skitter rats only)  
**SQ** expert climber  


**Ecology**


**Environment** underground or urban  
**Organization** solitary, pair, pack (3-12) or warren (13-40)  
**Treasure** incidental  


**Special Abilities**


**Aura Sight (Su)** A skitter rat can determine the health aura of all living creatures it can see within 30 feet. This tells it if creatures are at full health or injured, and whether it possesses any of the following conditions—confused, disabled, diseased, dying, nauseated, panicked, poisoned, staggered, stunned or unconscious.  

**Expert Climber (Ex)** A skitter rat gains a +16 racial bonus to Climb checks, and can climb sheer surfaces or upside down as per a spider climb spell.  

**Swarming (Ex)** Up to two skitter rats can share the same space at the same time. If two skitter rats in the same space attack the same foe, they are considered to be flanking that foe.
